entities.name: Jorge Aragão
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jorge Aragão da Cruz is a Brazilian musician, singer-songwriter, working in the genres of samba and pagode. He is a multi-instrumentalist, and plays the guitar, surdo, cavaco and banjo, among other instruments. In performance, he usually plays the cavaquinho most of the show, and sometimes the banjo.
